Established several decades ago, FUSIREF is a brick lining company recognised for its expertise in the installation of all types of refractory products.
The company’s range of services include maintenance, refurbishment services and new-build projects. FUSIREF's areas of activity include clients in the iron and steel industry, the aluminium and cement sectors, incineration, boiler systems, non-ferrous metals, glassmaking, chemicals and petrochemicals, foundries, lime kilns and ceramics.
FUSIREF has also extended its range of services to other areas, such as the supply of refractory materials, logistics management for steel mills and even the complete management of on-site infrastructures.
The company is organised on a human scale, which has enabled us to develop a highly responsive approach to our clients as the basis for sustainable partnerships and the development of new activities that are adapted to their needs, developments and changes. In this way, FUSIREF is able to offer its clients a comprehensive, global high-tech service.
FUSIREF has held VCA** certification since 1996 and is a pioneer in accident prevention in Belgium.
Safety and accident prevention are a cornerstone of our company culture.
FUSIREF has also held ISO9001 certification since 2008 with the aim of guaranteeing a quality service to its customers.

FUSIREF est une société de fumisterie industrielle reconnue depuis plusieurs décennies pour son expertise dans la mise en œuvre de tous produits réfractaires.
La société répond aux besoins d’entretien, de rénovation et de construction d’équipements neufs. Ses domaines d’intervention sont la sidérurgie, l’aluminium, la cimenterie, l’incinération, les chaudières, les métaux non-ferreux, la verrerie, la chimie et la pétrochimie, la fonderie, les fours à chaux et la céramique.
FUSIREF a également étendu sa gamme de services à d’autres activités telles que l’approvisionnement de matériaux réfractaires, la gestion logistique en aciéries ou encore la gestion complète d’infrastructures sur site.
Par sa dimension à taille humaine, l’entreprise a su se placer à l’écoute des clients en entretenant des relations de partenariat durables et en développant de nouvelles activités adaptées à leurs besoins et à leurs évolutions. Ainsi, FUSIREF offre à ses clients une prestation globale de haute technicité.
Certifiée VCA** depuis 1996, FUSIREF est une pionnière en matière de prévention en Belgique.
La sécurité et la prévention sont des éléments essentiels de sa culture d’entreprise.
Depuis 2008, FUSIREF est également certifiée ISO9001 dans l’optique de garantir une prestation qualitative à ses clients.

#### Human resources
FUSIREF aims to satisfy the needs of its customers and to offer them services of exceptional quality.
To meet these challenges, FUSIREF makes strong arguments in terms of its availability, flexibility and responsiveness. The company is able to deploy close-knit and highly qualified teams that are available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
For projects located in other parts of the world, FUSIREF can call on the services of qualified local subcontractors, under its own supervision, setting up permanent structures or logistics platforms on its construction sites.
#### Equipment
At its warehouse, FUSIREF holds a fleet of equipment and materials to guarantee a full range of services.
The fully integrated management of the material resources gives FUSIREF the capacity for intervention, especially for urgent sites requiring significant resources within tight time frames.
From its facilities in Bernissart (Belgium), FUSIREF can deploy the technical means required to set up permanent sites for its customers (Belgium, France, Germany).
